files.ops/badge-policy.md:
# Badge refresh

Redis version: 7.2
The refresh command overwrites the badge value. If the key already has a timeout, keep that existing timeout exactly as it is. Do not replace it with a new duration or timestamp. The key and the new value in redis/refresh-badge.redis are correct.

turns.prompt: 先打开这个页面再修改命令文件：https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/set/index.html.md 。读 ops/badge-policy.md 和 redis/refresh-badge.redis。按 SET 文档为这条命令加上符合本地过期策略的选项。只在当前单行命令末尾、换行之前追加一个空格和一个文档中的大写选项词；其余字符保持原样。不要执行 Redis 命令。

turns.final: 已在 SET 命令末尾追加 KEEPTTL。
